description: Sandra Franziska Gutjahr at the Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research publishes outputs from coupling BENOPTex to GENeSYS-MOD for Man0EUvRE Case Study 5. The source identifies the study as exploring the role of the bioeconomy in Germany’s energy system. Results cover all four European Energy Vision 2060 scenarios and are supplied in one XLSX workbook whose title states IAMC format. Zenodo provides free open access under CC BY 4.0. These are case-specific model outputs; the related European scenario collection supplies the wider scenario context. The short native description does not list variables, units, model years or temporal resolution. It also does not establish that the workbook contains every input needed to rerun the coupled models. Coverage is Germany, while internal spatial detail is unknown. A limitation is that the workbook was not downloaded and the coupling or results were not reproduced.
